To develop a year round free style skiing training facility and enter into a sublease agreement with OSP community development corporation.
That's committee will recall the city entered into an ember memorandum agreement with OSP in 2019, and within that agreement OSP may enter into a sublease with permission from the city.
Saskatoon free style has been in discussions with OSP to utilize a portion of the south side of optimist hill to develop a year round free style skiing training facility.
Appendix one of the report provides visual references for the area that is being proposed.
This facility's access will be exclusively controlled by Saskatoon free style and there will be no impact to the public's access of optimist hill.

The training facility has a potential to operate beyond the winter season using features included but not limited to trampolines, jib rails, all season dry slopes, landing airbags, former air pits, and other features consistent with freestyle skiing and boarding.
The development of this amenity would provide Saskatoon free style with a training site so local athletes could train and would not be required to leave the province to complete their training.

Administration including solicitors has reviewed and supports the request by OSP and Saskatoon free style to develop the south side of optimist hill in principle, subject to the Saskatoon free style meeting the terms and conditions that are outlined in the report.
There are no financial implication to the city for this arrangement.
